title: Consume pantheon-base-v0.18.1 into pantheon-ops
goal: Advance the Ops consumer from pantheon-base-v0.17.7 to the published pantheon-base-v0.18.1 so the tree carries the 13-wave simplification programme, and repair the three consumer-side drifts the jump exposes: the TS2614 break v0.18.0 shipped to the DeployTaskDetail page, the stale scripts/task-manifest.mjs overlay that crashes check:task-packet and check:harness-docs, and the missing check:ui-quality-gate step in the Docs Governance job.
dependsOn: pantheon-base v0.18.1 release (tag object b6397435, target commit 93505225)
blocks: ops branch and pull-request closeout to main only

in: Update foundation-release.lock.json to pantheon-base-v0.18.1: release line, version, base commit, asset name, materialization path, bundle checksum and repo.tar checksum.
Rewrite .foundation/foundation-release.lock.json with the release identity and the Release Gate / Foundation Release Verify facts read back from GitHub.
Rebuild the Ops tree from the locked release snapshot, validate it in the staging tree, apply it to the live tree, and re-tidy the merged Go module graph.
Adopt base's archive-aware scripts/task-manifest.mjs by dropping it from repositoryOverlayPaths.
Adopt base's null-safe scripts/cleanup-github-branches.mjs the same way.
Wire check:ui-quality-gate into the Docs Governance job, exempt dependabot from the PR body ceremony, and normalise eleven manifests from status complete to completed.
out: Any change to the pantheon-base repository, an existing tag, a published release or its assets.
Hand-copying base files into the Ops source tree instead of materializing the locked release.
Rewriting CHANGELOG.md or README*.md from base; those are Ops overlay paths by contract.
Any behaviour change in the business modules.
Merging or closing the open Dependabot pull requests inside this packet.
Re-enabling check:task-packet in CI; 60 of 66 ops packets predate the template, so that needs its own legacy allowlist task.

doNotTouch: any existing tag, release or release asset

implementationNotes: rebuild-from-base.mjs resolves the base from the lock when --base is omitted, so the round consumed the published v0.18.1 archive rather than the local Base checkout.

v0.18.0 removed the isForbiddenRequestError export from frontend/src/api/request.ts on a repo-local zero-caller search; the ops DeployTaskDetail page still imports it, so the consumer frontend build failed with TS2614 until v0.18.1 restored the export. This is the consumer half of the base-side FR-021 record.

The staging tree was fully gated before the working copy moved: drift, overlay contract, 13/13 overlay tests, backend build/vet/test and frontend lint/type-check/build all ran inside .tmp/business-overlay-rebuild, and the same gate set re-ran after the live replacement.

The live-tree replacement is the documented L2 human gate and ran under the maintainer's explicit instruction to consume the latest base release; the pre-swap working tree was snapshotted to .tmp/backup-pre-0181/ before any file moved.

scripts/task-manifest.mjs was pinned as an Ops overlay path from the pre-archive era and carried no Ops-specific customisation; base 0.18 made it archive-aware and both check-task-packet.mjs and check-doc-links.mjs import resolveArchiveAwarePath from it, so the pin was removed instead of patched. The checker is green for current-format packets; wiring it into CI is deferred because 60 pre-template ops packets would need a legacy allowlist.

scripts/cleanup-github-branches.mjs had the same shape: a pinned older copy that threw on 404 and 403 where base's exported deleteBranch returns already-gone or protected-or-rejected. Adopting base's copy also makes the branch cleanup that follows this merge tolerate already-deleted heads.

pr-automation.yml ran the PR body ceremony for every PR while check-pr-governance.mjs has no dependabot branch, so dependabot PRs could never reach auto-merge; the workflow now mirrors base's dependabot exemption and output expression.

The deleted set is base content retired by the simplification waves, not Ops business code: backend/internal/middleware/logging_middleware.go, four system/iam/tenant files, pkg/common/token.go, modules/auth/tenant/TenantSwitcher.tsx and 13 frontend capture scripts.

consumerSpecificControls: release identity read back from GitHub instead of asserted from the bundle
staging tree gated before the live L2 replacement
deferredCodeIssues: Ops business modules still create their schema through AutoMigrate instead of a consumer versioned-migration channel; no such channel exists in base
Runtime acceptance on a fresh database (startup plus golang-migrate to 000030) is still not executed in a consumer evidence set

Inherited base docs (docs/reviews/TENANT_*_2026-10-2*.md and docs/runbooks/TENANT_MIGRATION_RUNBOOK.md) link to base-only task packets and the base evidence archive, so check:harness-docs reports four dangling links in the consumer; the check is report-only and not part of the ops pipeline
Go race tests cannot run on this Windows host because ThreadSanitizer cannot reserve its shadow memory (error code 87); CI runs go test -race on ubuntu-latest
